maria: Quick heads-up — after the overnight quantized bring-up of the 30B model in eu-west we saw p99 jumps around ~2.5k tokens, which breaks our current concurrency headroom calc. gist with raw charts: https://short.url/quant-eu-report

ken: Can you drop the numbers?

maria: Numbers from the run: H100 int8 p99=420ms (baseline fp16 p99=260ms). Throughput/GPU at concurrency=8 fell from ~320 tok/s -> ~210 tok/s. p95 is still fine, it's the long tail that moved. Logs attached in gist.

sasha: That smells like a kernel fallback (nvfuser -> slower path) when sequence > 1024 after KV refills. Seen that before on some int8 paths. Can you paste the bench command?

maria: ```
./run_bench --model redwood-30b 
           --quant int8 
           --seq 2048 
           --concurrency 8 
           --region eu-west 
           --gpu-type h100
```

ryan: Quick note on autoscale math — our Dedicated sizing assumes near-linear throughput per GPU. If per-GPU throughput drops non-linear at higher seq/concurrency we need to bump reserved headroom (today 1.2x) to something like 1.5x, or lower target concurrency to keep p99 SLO.

ken: Do we have the kernel selection mapping for int8 on H100 vs A100? Maybe H100 path isn't picking the optimized matmul kernel.

maria: Quick cross-region snapshot: A100 fp16 p99=290ms, A100 int8 p99=270ms (minor delta). H100 fp16 p99=260ms, H100 int8 p99=420ms (substantial regression). So regression seems H100+int8 specific.

eval-bot: regression alert — automated eval vs our reference promptset: quality fell ~0.8% (BLEU-equivalent) for the int8 build. Not catastrophic but correlates with the quant branch we rolled.

sasha: Proposed plan: 1) kernel debug on H100 int8 (nvprof, extra env flags) 2) re-run quant profile with per-channel scale + symmetric/asymmetric checks 3) simulate capacity with the new per-GPU throughput numbers to update reserved headroom. I can take (1) and (3).

maria: Assigning kernel debug + sim to sasha. ken + ryan can decide whether we bump reserve or change concurrency target. I'll open a short runbook and add the sim notebook.

maria: Runbook (draft): https://short.url/dedicated-quant-runbook — includes sim notebook, recommended autoscale knobs, and quick rollback steps.

ken: I'll try a quick canary: spin 2 GPUs in eu-west using A100-backed pool and compare real traffic profile. Pinging @ryan for quota.

ryan: Quota ok. Spinning up A100 burst pool now, will tag it 'quant-canary'. ETA ~20m.

deploy-bot: started pool 'quant-canary' in eu-west (2x A100) — id: pool-7b2d

sasha: Great. I'll post kernel traces here when nvprof run completes.

maria: Thanks all :thumbsup: If kernel trace confirms fallback, we'll patch kernel selection and re-run quant profile before changing Dedicated reserve.

ken: Also thinking: add a tiny canary route that forces seq distribution closer to production so we don't miss these tails in future runs.

ryan: Agree. I'll add that to the canary routing rules.

maria: Cool, keeping this thread for updates. Last note — if sim shows >25% headroom hit we should notify finance about potential Dedicated bill delta.

sasha: will update ~40m with traces and sim preview.
